about: Does a film about something real use the real thing: its facts from the web, its own logo, colours, type and product, instead of an invented stand-in? Made for web research in the studio (2026-09-28), after the Instafill.ai GPT-6 Sol announcement studio-20260928-135513-pizula came out with a drawn stand-in logo, an invented UI in a comic font and no research ('This studio has no web access'). The first prompt is that film's own; the control has nothing real to look up, and must not get worse or go looking.

prompts.audience: adults: Instafill.ai's own users, a product announcement
prompts.prompt: Research about Instafill.ai. we recently upgraded all users to gpt 6 Sol model as default model. We need a video about this that explains that it's smarter and faster and now Instafill.ai users have access to the top tier model

prompts.audience: adults: a general audience, a company's product
prompts.prompt: A short explainer about Cloudflare's 1.1.1.1 DNS resolver: what it is, why it is fast and private, and how to switch to it.

prompts.audience: children at bedtime (control: nothing real to look up)
prompts.prompt: A bedtime story about a lighthouse keeper's cat who is afraid of the dark, until one stormy night.
